description: Periodic (quarterly) Council self-audit of junkan against gates G1..G13. The const-field zero-counters are the structural teeth of the analysis-only discipline: any nonzero actuationEventsCount or outwardChannelAcquiredCount is a CRITICAL finding that halts junkan and escalates to chigiri.disputeMediation. Requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation per emission (G13).

actuationEventsCount.description: G4 STRUCTURAL: const 0 — any nonzero is critical (junkan took an outward action)

outwardChannelAcquiredCount.description: G4 STRUCTURAL: const 0 — junkan acquired NO post/mention/email/tx/actuator capability

causalOverclaimEventsCount.description: G5 STRUCTURAL: const 0 — no finding asserted proven causation

individualModelingEventsCount.description: G6 STRUCTURAL: const 0 — aggregate-only, no individual modeled

prescriptionGivenEventsCount.description: G11 STRUCTURAL: const 0 — no directives issued

loopsAnalyzedCount.description: Volume metric — how many loops were under analysis this period
